title: त्रिसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 73 · Who is to be king: the story of Aila

summary.en: Bhishma says that the king is the one who protects the good and checks the wicked, and tells the debate between King Aila and the wind-god on who owns the earth. The wind says that the earth belongs to the brahmin and the king holds it in trust.
summary.kn: ಸಜ್ಜನರನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ದುಷ್ಟರನ್ನು ನಿಗ್ರಹಿಸುವವನೇ ರಾಜನೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳಿ ಭೂಮಿ ಯಾರದೆಂಬ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ರಾಜ ಐಲ ಮತ್ತು ವಾಯುವಿನ ವಾದ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಭೂಮಿ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣನದು, ರಾಜ ಅದನ್ನು ನ್ಯಾಸವಾಗಿ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆಂದು ವಾಯು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीष्म कहते हैं कि राजा वही है जो सज्जनों की रक्षा और दुष्टों का निग्रह करे, और राजा ऐल तथा वायु का इस पर संवाद सुनाते हैं कि पृथ्वी किसकी है। वायु कहते हैं कि पृथ्वी ब्राह्मण की है और राजा उसे न्यास की तरह रखता है।
summary.te: సజ్జనులను రక్షించి దుష్టులను నిగ్రహించేవాడే రాజని భీష్ముడు చెప్పి భూమి ఎవరిదనే దానిపై రాజు ఐల, వాయువుల వాదనను చెబుతాడు. భూమి బ్రాహ్మణునిదని, రాజు దాన్ని న్యాసంగా ఉంచుకుంటాడని వాయువు అంటాడు.
summary.ta: நல்லோரைக் காத்துத் தீயோரை அடக்குபவனே மன்னன் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறி, நிலம் யாருடையது என்பதில் மன்னன் ஐலனுக்கும் வாயுவுக்கும் நடந்த வாதத்தைச் சொல்கிறார். நிலம் அந்தணனுடையது, மன்னன் அதை அடைக்கலமாகக் கொள்கிறான் என்கிறான் வாயு.
summary.ml: നല്ലവരെ സംരക്ഷിക്കുകയും ദുഷ്ടരെ തടയുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നവനാണ് രാജാവെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു; ഭൂമി ആർക്കെന്ന ഐലരാജാവും വായുദേവനും തമ്മിലുള്ള തർക്കം അദ്ദേഹം വിവരിക്കുന്നു. ഭൂമി ബ്രാഹ്മണന്റേതാണെന്നും രാജാവ് അത് ഒരു ധനനിക്ഷേപമായി സൂക്ഷിക്കുകയാണെന്നും വായു പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.73; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
य एव तु सतो रक्षेदसतश्च निबर्हयेत् ।
स एव राज्ञा कर्तव्यो राजन्राजपुरोहितः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of men, the one who protects the good and destroys the wicked is the one a king should appoint as his household priest.

verses.text:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
पुरूरवस ऐलस्य संवादं मातरिश्वनः ॥

meaning.en: On this they cite an ancient tale, the conversation of Pururavas, son of Ila, with Matarishvan, the wind.

verses.text: ऐल उवाच

meaning.en: Aila said:

verses.text:
कुतः स्विद्ब्राह्मणो जातो वर्णाश्चापि कुतस्त्रयः ।
कस्माच्च भवति श्रेयानेतद्वायो विचक्ष्व मे ॥

meaning.en: Wind, tell me: from where was the Brahmana born, and from where the three other classes? And why does he become the best?

verses.text: वायुरुवाच

meaning.en: Vayu said:

verses.text:
ब्रह्मणो मुखतः सृष्टो ब्राह्मणो राजसत्तम ।
बाहुभ्यां क्षत्रियः सृष्ट ऊरुभ्यां वैश्य उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: Best of kings, the Brahmana was created from the mouth of Brahma, the Kshatriya from his arms, and the Vaishya is said to come from his thighs.

verses.text:
वर्णानां परिचर्यार्थं त्रयाणां पुरुषर्षभ ।
वर्णश्चतुर्थः पश्चात्तु पद्भ्यां शूद्रो विनिर्मितः ॥

meaning.en: Bull among men, for the service of the three classes the fourth, the Shudra, was afterwards formed from his feet.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणो जातमात्रस्तु पृथिवीमन्वजायत ।
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां धर्मकोशस्य गुप्तये ॥

meaning.en: As soon as born, the Brahmana came to the earth as lord of all beings, to guard the treasury of righteousness.

verses.text:
ततः पृथिव्या गोप्तारं क्षत्रियं दण्डधारिणम् ।
द्वितीयं वर्णमकरोत्प्रजानामनुगुप्तये ॥

meaning.en: Then for the protection of the people he made the second class, the Kshatriya, protector of the earth and bearer of the rod.

verses.text:
वैश्यस्तु धनधान्येन त्रीन्वर्णान्बिभृयादिमान् ।
शूद्रो ह्येनान्परिचरेदिति ब्रह्मानुशासनम् ॥

meaning.en: The Vaishya was to support these three classes with wealth and grain, and the Shudra was to serve them; such is Brahma's command.

verses.text: ऐल उवाच

meaning.en: Aila said:

verses.text:
द्विजस्य क्षत्रबन्धोर्वा कस्येयं पृथिवी भवेत् ।
धर्मतः सह वित्तेन सम्यग्वायो प्रचक्ष्व मे ॥

meaning.en: Wind, tell me fully, according to righteousness and wealth: to whom does this earth belong, to the twice-born or to the Kshatriya?

verses.text: वायुरुवाच

meaning.en: Vayu said:

verses.text:
विप्रस्य सर्वमेवैतद्यत्किंचिज्जगतीगतम् ।
ज्येष्ठेनाभिजनेनेह तद्धर्मकुशला विदुः ॥

meaning.en: All that there is on earth belongs to the Brahmana; so those skilled in righteousness know, by reason of being eldest and of birth.

verses.text:
स्वमेव ब्राह्मणो भुङ्क्ते स्वं वस्ते स्वं ददाति च ।
गुरुर्हि सर्ववर्णानां ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठश्च वै द्विजः ॥

meaning.en: The Brahmana enjoys only his own, wears only his own, and gives only his own; for the twice-born is the teacher, eldest and best of all classes.

verses.text:
पत्यभावे यथा स्त्री हि देवरं कुरुते पतिम् ।
आनन्तर्यात्तथा क्षत्रं पृथिवी कुरुते पतिम् ॥

meaning.en: As a woman takes her husband's brother as husband when she has no husband, so, by being next in order, the earth takes the Kshatriya as her husband.

verses.text:
एष ते प्रथमः कल्प आपद्यन्यो भवेदतः ।
यदि स्वर्गे परं स्थानं धर्मतः परिमार्गसि ॥

meaning.en: This is the first rule for you; the other is for times of distress, if you seek the highest place in heaven by righteousness.

verses.text:
यः कश्चिद्विजयेद्भूमिं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ।
श्रुतवृत्तोपपन्नाय धर्मज्ञाय तपस्विने ॥

meaning.en: Whoever conquers land should hand it over to a Brahmana who is learned and of good conduct, who knows righteousness and practises austerity.

verses.text:
स्वधर्मपरितृप्ताय यो न वित्तपरो भवेत् ।
यो राजानं नयेद्बुद्ध्या सर्वतः परिपूर्णया ॥

meaning.en: He should give it to one content with his own duty and not bent on wealth, who can guide the king with understanding that is complete on every side.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणो हि कुले जातः कृतप्रज्ञो विनीतवाक् ।
श्रेयो नयति राजानं ब्रुवंश्चित्रां सरस्वतीम् ॥

meaning.en: A Brahmana born in a good family, wise and gentle in speech, leads the king to what is best, speaking in varied and fine words.

verses.text:
राजा चरति यं धर्मं ब्राह्मणेन निदर्शितम् ।
शुश्रूषुरनहंवादी क्षत्रधर्मव्रते स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: The king who obeys, free of conceit, and keeps to the vow of the Kshatriya duty, follows the righteousness shown by the Brahmana.

verses.text:
तावता स कृतप्रज्ञश्चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति ।
तस्य धर्मस्य सर्वस्य भागी राजपुरोहितः ॥

meaning.en: By that much he, accomplished in wisdom, stays long in fame; and the king's household priest shares in all that righteousness.

verses.text:
एवमेव प्रजाः सर्वा राजानमभिसंश्रिताः ।
सम्यग्वृत्ताः स्वधर्मस्था न कुतश्चिद्भयान्विताः ॥

meaning.en: So too all the people who take refuge in the king and live rightly in their own duties are free of fear from any side.

verses.text:
राष्ट्रे चरन्ति यं धर्मं राज्ञा साध्वभिरक्षिताः ।
चतुर्थं तस्य धर्मस्य राजा भागं स विन्दति ॥

meaning.en: The righteousness the people practise in the kingdom, well protected by the king, a fourth part of it the king obtains.

verses.text:
देवा मनुष्याः पितरो गन्धर्वोरगराक्षसाः ।
यज्ञमेवोपजीवन्ति नास्ति चेष्टमराजके ॥

meaning.en: Gods, men, ancestors, gandharvas, serpents and rakshasas all live on sacrifice, and there is no sacrifice where there is no king.

verses.text:
इतो दत्तेन जीवन्ति देवताः पितरस्तथा ।
राजन्येवास्य धर्मस्य योगक्षेमः प्रतिष्ठितः ॥

meaning.en: What is given from here sustains the gods and ancestors, and in the king rests the gaining and keeping of this righteousness.

verses.text:
छायायामप्सु वायौ च सुखमुष्णेऽधिगच्छति ।
अग्नौ वाससि सूर्ये च सुखं शीतेऽधिगच्छति ॥

meaning.en: In shade, in water and in wind a man finds comfort in heat; in fire, in clothing and in the sun he finds comfort in cold.

verses.text:
शब्दे स्पर्शे रसे रूपे गन्धे च रमते मनः ।
तेषु भोगेषु सर्वेषु नभीतो लभते सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: The mind delights in sound, touch, taste, form and smell; a man finds happiness in all these pleasures when he is unafraid.

verses.text:
अभयस्यैव यो दाता तस्यैव सुमहत्फलम् ।
न हि प्राणसमं दानं त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: The one who gives fearlessness has the greatest reward; no gift in the three worlds equals the gift of life.

verses.text:
इन्द्रो राजा यमो राजा धर्मो राजा तथैव च ।
राजा बिभर्ति रूपाणि राज्ञा सर्वमिदं धृतम् ॥

meaning.en: The king is Indra, the king is Yama, the king is Dharma too; the king bears many forms, and by the king all this is upheld.
